notes: Lists Platinum learnset moves for each species and its pre-evolution line that also exist as selectable moves in the Wii Pokemon Rumble move table.
Rumble animation-chain, boss (B/M2), and test-only move records are excluded.
The full-box validation showed that evolved species retain pre-evolution roulette moves, so ancestor learnsets are included.
The unknown Hidden Power ? record is excluded; it is not a normal valid move.
